newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RTZ-CRA to invest $278 mln in Brazilian mines.
newsitem.headline: RTZ-CRA to invest $278 mln in Brazilian mines.

text.p: Anglo-Australian mining company RTZ-CRA will invest $278 million in two mines in Minas Gerais state, Brazil, during the coming two years, the company's director of corporate affairs said.

An electrolytic nickel mine located in Fortaleza de Minas will see investments of $233 million. The mine is scheduled to begin production in 1998 and produce as by-products cobalt, copper sulphate, platinum group metals and gold.
"We will start turning the equipment on at the end of this year but production will really get going in the first quarter of 1998," said Sergio Visconti.

The remaining $45 million will be invested in the expansion of the existing Morro do Ouro gold mine in Minas Gerais, which should bring annual output to 8.3 tonnes from the current 5.1 tonnes as well as prolonging the mine's lifespan.
Visconti said the $45 million is part of a $65 million investment plan announced last year by RTZ-CRA and its partner in the mine, AUTRAM Mineracao e Participoes.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
